speaker: Doctor
text: Did the rash appear shortly after starting any new medications for your arthritis, and has the cough been accompanied by fever or shortness of breath? I need to determine if this is a drug eruption or a systemic reaction.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Rash on the upper half of the back. I also have Concern over sudden onset, Recent cough, Unaware of exposure to new environmental stimuli, Mucositis.

speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of mucositis is a critical finding that, combined with the rash and recent new medication, strongly suggests a severe cutaneous adverse reaction. I need to rule out life-threatening conditions like Stevens-Johnson Syndrome, so please confirm if you have had any blistering of the skin or peeling of the mucous membranes.
